Since the old route key was removed from productRoutes with no replacement redirect, a request to '/ml-inference/decisions' would no longer resolve to any route rather than being redirected to the new address.

result:
The ML inference decisions playground is now served at `/ml-inference/playground` instead of `/ml-inference/decisions`, matching AI observability’s playground path.

The scene, its title, and its behavior are unchanged. Only the web route and the in-app URL builder moved.

- `products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx` is the source of truth. Its route now maps `/ml-inference/playground` to the existing `DecisionPlayground` scene, and `urls.decisionPlayground()` returns that path. Storybook and any other caller of that helper follow it automatically. The product has no menu or tree entries, and nothing else in the app hardcoded the old web path.
- `frontend/src/products.tsx` is generated from the manifests and is what the app actually routes on, so the same two strings were updated there. CI checks that file against a rebuild of the manifests.

The backend decide API stays at `ml_inference/decisions`. That path is the HTTP API, not the page address.
